Did you know that if a stump is left untreated, it can resprout? That means even after tree removal, a stump can cause you problems for years to come. Not to mention that it’s a breeding ground for fungus, mold, ants, and other pests. If left untreated, these pests can migrate to your home or other plants and cause thousands of dollars in damage.

That’s why we offer complete tree stump removal and grinding services. Our equipment allows us to remove stumps quickly, safely, and completely — leaving your yard smooth and ready for replanting or new landscaping. Whether it’s one small stump or several large ones, our experienced team handles each job with care and attention to detail. We’ll even clean up all debris so you’re left with a clean, level space.

Don’t let old stumps ruin your property’s look or safety. Give us a call today for your free estimate and let Chris’s Tree Service handle the hard work for you!
